net_paid_rule: Claim family = original CLAIM_ID. A reversal (status R, freq 8) repeats the original CLAIM_ID with negated amounts; a replacement (freq 7) has a new CLAIM_ID and ORIG_CLAIM_ID = the original. Voided -> 0; replaced -> the replacement's PAID_AMT; denied -> 0; otherwise the original's PAID_AMT. Equivalently SUM(PAID_AMT) over every row. Service month = month of the original SERVICE_FROM_DT.
